person.name: Ada_Lovelace
person.summary: Ada Lovelace was an English mathematician and writer known for her work on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine, and is often considered the first computer programmer.

events.title: Birth of Ada Lovelace
events.description: Augusta Ada Byron is born in London, England, to poet Lord Byron and Anne Isabella Milbanke.

location_coordinates.label: London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom
location_coordinates.name: London, England

events.title: Death of Lord Byron
events.description: Ada's father, Lord Byron, dies in Greece, leaving her without a relationship with him.

events.title: Ada's Interest in Flight
events.description: Ada begins her project to construct wings, inspired by her desire to fly, and documents her findings in a book titled 'Flyology'.

events.title: Portrait at Seventeen
events.description: A portrait of Ada Byron at the age of seventeen, showcasing her early beauty and intellect.

events.title: Meeting Charles Babbage
events.description: Ada meets Charles Babbage at one of his soirées, marking the beginning of a significant intellectual partnership.

location_coordinates.label: London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom
location_coordinates.name: London, England

events.title: Marriage to William King
events.description: Ada marries William King, 8th Baron King, and becomes Lady King.

events.title: Becomes Countess of Lovelace
events.description: William King is created Earl of Lovelace, making Ada the Countess of Lovelace.

events.title: Translation of Menabrea's Article
events.description: Ada translates an article by Luigi Federico Federico Menabrea on the Analytical Engine, adding her own notes, which are considered the first computer program.

events.title: First Published Computer Program
events.description: Ada's notes on the Analytical Engine describe a method for calculating Bernoulli numbers, recognized as the first computer program.

events.title: Teaching Children
events.description: Ada's mother assigns William Benjamin Carpenter to teach her children and act as a moral instructor, leading to a complicated relationship.

events.title: Death of Ada Lovelace
events.description: Ada Lovelace passes away in London, England, leaving behind a legacy as a pioneer in computing.
